svg.title: Pleasure Point — 3D Topography & Cliff Geometry
svg.desc: Extended 3D grid topography of Pleasure Point showing both the submerged seabed and coastal land cliff geometry from NOAA NCEI 1/3" coastal DEM.
svg.text: Submerged reef (0.50 m RMS, 1:58 ramp) extended to coastal terrace cliffs (+18 m NAVD88).
Waterline at MSL (+0.91 m NAVD88). Contour bearing 0° vs refracted crest 10° (9° peel angle).
Bathymetry & Topography: NOAA NCEI Monterey Bay 1/3″ coastal DEM, NAVD88. Coastline & spots: OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0).
MSL = NAVD88 +0.905 m (NOAA CO-OPS 9413450). Vertical exaggeration ×7.
T = 14 s, deep-water α = 58° · gridlines 30 m down-point × 20 m shore-normal
